name: Synthetic Taphonomic Deformation
description: This research pipeline processes 3D CT slice stacks of fossil specimens (8 specimens x 30 projections = 240 images per specimen) via orthographic maximum intensity projection (MIP) and rotational view generation. Outputs are used to train a deep learning Taphonomic Distortion Estimator that predicts morphological deformation caused by sedimentary burial. Implemented with ASCII-safe encoding for cross-platform Windows/Linux compatibility. Collaborative paleontological research project at VIT Chennai.
